subject: Running CellNEt with compiling older version of R, when R version 3 is installed

messages.author: 043f57a7b722e6c4
messages.subject: Running CellNEt with compiling older version of R, when R version 3 is installed
parts:
Dears,
I have ran CellNet on R version 2.15.3. However, I have to run it on a far server in which R version 3 is installed. A professor has told me "You should compile the old version of R on the server". I am using the command line on the remote server. Would you please inform me how to compile the old version of R, such that I can install packages like afyr, affy, anotationDbi, and others to finally install CellNet. Thanks
